subject: science
concept: Understanding rock types (igneous, sedimentary, metamorphic) and how they form
source_inspiration: adapted from NGSS Earth and Space Science Disciplinary Core Ideas (Earth Materials and Systems) — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student examines real or virtual rock samples and sorts them by appearance and likely formation process
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a rock type to its simplified formation diagram
exercise.abstract: Student explains how a described rock type forms

misconception_flags: sorts rocks purely by color/appearance rather than their actual formation process

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
